meta.description: Applies channel planning to reduce co-channel and adjacent-channel interference.

question.text: Users report poor Wi-Fi performance in a crowded office. A survey shows several nearby access points using overlapping 2.4 GHz channels. What is the best first configuration change to investigate?
options: Plan non-overlapping channel assignments for nearby access points
Disable encryption on every access point
Set every access point to the same maximum transmit power without testing
Change all clients to static IPv4 addresses
correctAnswers: Plan non-overlapping channel assignments for nearby access points
